skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Helps draft internal communications such as 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports using structured company-style formats.
skill.summary: Drafts concise internal updates, newsletters, FAQs, and reports using reusable communication formats.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: All six static findings are false positives caused by markdown formatting or writing-style guidance. No prompt injection, command execution, or malicious behavior was found. A low-severity semantic risk remains because the skill encourages broad aggregation from internal communication systems without explicit privacy guardrails.

remediation.suggestion: Add explicit instructions to use only user-authorized sources, confirm the audience and sensitivity level, and omit private, confidential, or irrelevant employee information from drafts.

content.value_statement: Internal updates often lose clarity when each team uses a different format. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft concise updates, newsletters, FAQs, and reports from structured guidance.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Creates company newsletter outlines with grouped announcement sections.
Turns repeated employee questions into concise FAQ entries.
Guides status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
Asks for missing audience, purpose, tone, and format details.
Uses provided or authorized source material to produce concise internal drafts.
limitations: It cannot access Slack, email, calendars, or documents unless those tools are available and authorized.
It does not verify company facts without source material from the user or connected tools.
It does not replace legal, HR, finance, or executive approval for sensitive announcements.
It may need organization-specific style rules for final polish.

use_cases.title: Summarize a Team Week
use_cases.description: Create a short 3P update that executives can read quickly.

use_cases.title: Prepare Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Convert major announcements, milestones, and links into a company-wide newsletter draft.

use_cases.title: Answer Common Employee Questions
use_cases.description: Collect repeated questions and draft clear FAQ answers with source links.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with direct source notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for the [team name] team covering [dates]. Use these notes: [paste notes]. Keep it concise and data-driven.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Weekly Newsletter
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a company-wide summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company-wide newsletter for [week or month]. Group the content into clear sections and include these announcements, links, and milestones: [paste source material].

prompt_templates.title: Build an Employee FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these employee questions and source notes into an internal FAQ. Use one-sentence questions, short answers, and links to authoritative sources: [paste material].

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Multi-Source Updates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using connected workplace context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Using only authorized sources for [date range], draft a leadership-ready internal update for [audience]. Highlight major decisions, risks, launches, and open questions. Flag anything that needs approval.

output_examples.input: Notes for the mobile team: shipped onboarding redesign, next week starts crash-rate work, blocked by analytics delay.
output_examples.output:
Mobile Team (June 24-28)
Progress: Shipped the onboarding redesign and completed rollout monitoring.
Plans: Start crash-rate reduction work next week.
Problems: Analytics delays are slowing measurement and follow-up decisions.

output_examples.input: Employees keep asking when the new office policy starts and where to find the details.
output_examples.output:
Question: When does the new office policy start?
Answer: The policy starts on the announced effective date. Employees should review the official policy document and ask People Operations about role-specific exceptions.

output_examples.input: Prepare a newsletter from launch news, hiring milestones, leadership notes, and customer wins.
output: Company Announcements: Summarize leadership notes and decisions that affect most employees.
Progress on Priorities: Group launch news, customer wins, and hiring milestones by business area.
Open Questions: Flag items that need executive confirmation before publication.

best_practices: Provide the audience, date range, source material, and approval status before drafting.
Use authoritative links for facts, decisions, metrics, and policy details.
Review drafts for confidentiality, role-specific sensitivity, and executive approval needs.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent company facts, metrics, decisions, or quotes.
Do not include private employee details unless they are approved for the target audience.
Do not publish sensitive announcements without the required internal review.

faq.question: What communication formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ answers, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Can it search Slack, email, calendar, or documents?
faq.answer: Only when those tools are available and the user has authorized access. Otherwise, it works from provided notes and links.

faq.question: Does it make final publishing decisions?
faq.answer: No. A human owner should review sensitive, executive, HR, legal, financial, or incident communications before publication.

faq.question: How much context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, date range, purpose, key facts, links, and any required tone or format rules.

faq.question: Can it adapt to my company style?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide examples or style rules, and it can draft within those expectations.

faq.question: Is it useful without workplace connectors?
faq.answer: Yes. It can format and polish internal communications from notes, documents, and source excerpts that you provide.
